# Autogenerated Pages Canon Plan

## Owned Concern

`GD-MAND-AUTOGEN-PAGES` owns canonization of the autogenerated pages extraction
proposal into a governed component with explicit rails, invariants, user
stories, and semantic CI coverage.

## Fowler Analysis

| Scenario                                                             | Opportunity                                 | Fowler pattern                                     | DDD owner                                | Command/query rail              | Implementation surfaces            | Unit or package test                          | Architecture test   | User-flow test             | Out of scope                |
| -------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------- | ------------------------------- | ---------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------- | ------------------- | -------------------------- | --------------------------- |
| Classify generated documentation surfaces before extraction          | Primitive obsession and documentation drift | Replace Type Code with value-object classification | Generated docs surface registry          | `ClassifyGeneratedDocsSurface`  | Proposal, runbook, component guide | `tools/ci/autogenerated-pages-canon.test.mjs` | Same semantic guard | none - internal governance | removing tracked pages      |
| Extract eligible generated pages without losing navigation authority | Boundary drift                              | Service Layer plus Explicit Gateway                | Generated artifact extraction policy     | `ExtractGeneratedDocsSurface`   | Runbook and component guide        | `tools/ci/autogenerated-pages-canon.test.mjs` | Same semantic guard | none - internal governance | CI script rewrite           |
| Validate extracted artifacts as build outputs                        | Test-only confidence                        | Semantic fitness function                          | Generated artifact validation read model | `ValidateGeneratedDocsArtifact` | Runbook, component guide, CI test  | `tools/ci/autogenerated-pages-canon.test.mjs` | Same semantic guard | none - internal governance | publishing pipeline changes |

## Mature-System Comparison

Mature documentation systems do not treat generated files as ordinary authored
source. They keep canonical source documents, generation policy, artifact
validation, and publication outputs in separate concerns. This canon applies
that posture without a big-bang migration:

- authored docs remain canonical source;
- `must-track` surfaces stay versioned while they carry governance navigation;
- `candidate-for-extraction` surfaces can move to artifact validation only
  after `ValidateGeneratedDocsArtifact` proves deterministic output;
- extraction decisions flow through `ClassifyGeneratedDocsSurface` before
  `ExtractGeneratedDocsSurface` changes tracked state.

## Antipatterns Removed

- Generated-file churn as reviewer burden.
- Hidden authority where generated indexes silently decide governance
  navigation.
- Big-bang extraction risk without rollback.
- CI false confidence that only proves files exist, not that generated surface
  ownership is coherent.

## Drift And Repetition Fixed

The 2026-04-03 extraction proposal, the planning generated artifacts runbook,
the documentation-governance domain note, component guide, user stories, and
mailbox analysis now use the same rails:

- `ClassifyGeneratedDocsSurface`
- `ExtractGeneratedDocsSurface`
- `ValidateGeneratedDocsArtifact`

## User Stories

1. As a documentation maintainer, I want generated pages classified before
   extraction so that canonical navigation is not accidentally removed.
2. As a governance operator, I want extracted pages validated as artifacts so
   that CI remains deterministic without tracking low-signal files.
3. As an architecture reviewer, I want one component guide for generated page
   ownership so that future PRs do not invent local extraction rules.
4. As a contributor, I want fewer generated-file conflicts so that docs PRs
   focus on authored content and evidence.

## Decision

Accept the phased extraction posture from
[Autogenerated Pages Extraction Plan](./autogenerated-pages-extraction-plan-20260403.md)
and promote its operating model into the
[Autogenerated Pages Canon Component](../../../architecture/components/ci-governance/autogenerated-pages-canon-component.md).

No generated page is removed from tracking in this slice. The implementation is
documentation, component guidance, and semantic CI coverage only.

## ADR Decision

No new ADR is required. Existing documentation governance and command/query
rail governance already establish that generated surface extraction must be
represented by named rails before future implementation changes tracked state.
